title: Calculator
subtitle: See how your investments can grow with daily compound returns

intro.title: What is compound interest?
intro.p1: Compound interest means you earn interest on interest. When you trade with a daily return, the profit from each day is added to your capital and generates new profit the next day.
intro.p2: This calculator shows how much you can earn in one year of consistent trading, based on your starting capital and expected daily return.

disclaimer.title: Important information
disclaimer.text: This is a theoretical calculation. Actual trading results may vary significantly. Daily returns of 1-4% are very ambitious and require substantial expertise. Past performance is no guarantee of future results.
